visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large, golden-brown loaf of bread sits on a metal cooling rack over a white marble surface. Light white flour is dusted over its crust, which has a distinct cross-shaped score and dark raisins visible. The background is a clean, modern kitchen setting. (2) Inside a black bread machine pan, a ball of pale dough rotates and mixes. Streaks of yellow, likely butter or egg, are visible on the surface. Later, dark raisins and nuts are incorporated into the dough as it turns. (3) On a white marble countertop, a person's hands use a white plastic scraper to divide the dough. A digital scale in the background ensures even portions. The hands skillfully roll the dough into smooth rounds and arrange them on a baking tray lined with grey parchment paper. (4) A close-up shows the control panel of a HEALSIO steam oven, set to 40 degrees for fermentation. After rising, the person sprays water and sifts flour over the dough balls. A scoring tool is used to cut deep crosses into the surface, and small yellow butter strips are placed inside the cuts. (5) The tray is slid into the oven. The display indicates a temperature of 200 degrees and a 16-minute timer. As time passes, the bread expands and turns a rich, toasted brown. Once done, the tray is pulled out, revealing perfectly baked, crusty loaves. (6) The baked bread is sliced on a black mat, revealing a soft, airy interior filled with raisins. Slices are placed into a pastel green Aladdin toaster. After toasting, the slices appear golden and crispy. A hand uses clear tongs to scrape the surface, demonstrating the crunch.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a cheerful, mid-tempo acoustic pop track featuring bright piano notes and a light rhythmic backing. There are no vocals. The atmosphere is warm and welcoming, typical of a lifestyle or culinary presentation. BGM continues at a steady pace. (2) A mechanical whirring sound of the bread machine motor starts at approximately 2 seconds, layered over the music. This sound has a low-frequency hum and a rhythmic churning quality. The BGM remains dominant but the mechanical noise is clearly audible. (3) A series of high-pitched digital beeps occurs at 22 seconds as the oven buttons are pressed. This is followed by a soft, misty hiss of a water spray bottle being used. The BGM maintains its steady, major-key tonality throughout these sound events. (4) The distinct, percussive crunch of a bread knife slicing through a hard crust is heard at 40 seconds. The toaster lever engages with a heavy click at 46 seconds. Finally, a sharp, rhythmic scratching sound of tongs against a toasted surface confirms the bread's crisp texture.
